content.text:
The Choose Pro button on the highlighted plan is now green with white text. I checked the computed styles in a browser and it renders as `rgb(26, 127, 55)`, which is `--color-success`, the colour of the success messages. The rule is in `site/css/pages.css` and only affects the button inside `.plan-featured`. The other buttons are unchanged.

I also added a hover state, since the old teal hover colour would have looked wrong on a green button. It darkens the green by 15%. Tell me if you'd like a different hover.

All 16 functional tests pass. All 12 visual tests pass too, but that result is misleading. The approved pricing screenshots, desktop and phone, still show the teal button. The comparison is too tolerant to notice a teal-to-green change on one button. I didn't update the screenshots because you didn't ask. If you want them to match the new look, run `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots`.

STATUS: DONE
